title: Petition of Algonquin Gas Transmission Company requesting authority from the Department of Public Utilities to take by eminent domain under G.L. c. 79 and c. 164, such rights-of-way, easements or other interests in land, or other property as may be necessary and have not been previously acquired, for the construction, operation, maintenance, alteration and removal of natural gas transmission pipeline and appurtenant facilities situated in the Town of Braintree along the route of line I-8. The proposed pipeline will originate at Algonquin's existing East Braintree Meter Station and will traverse generally northeast to the site of the Potter Electric Generating Station of the Town of Braintree Electric Light Department. The pipeline extension will end at said Electric Generating Station at the site of a new Potter Meter Station.
